scope: bounded POSIX Coding baseline; not general coding benchmark

cases.task: Use at most one tool call and do not test. Create /workspace/add.sh, a POSIX shell script taking exactly two signed base-10 integer arguments in the range -1000000 to 1000000 and printing their sum plus a newline. Accept optional plus/minus signs and leading zeroes as decimal. Reject invalid argument count, malformed integer or out-of-range values with exit code 2 and no stdout. Add no dependencies, keep work in /workspace, do not modify hidden metadata, then finish concisely.

Use at most one tool call and do not test. Create /workspace/count.sh, a POSIX shell script taking exactly one existing readable regular text file path. Print the number of nonblank lines plus a newline; lines containing only spaces or tabs are blank. Handle spaces in filenames and a last line without a newline. An empty file prints 0. Invalid argument count, missing file or directory path exits 2 with no stdout. Use only POSIX shell and standard awk/sed utilities, keep work in /workspace, do not modify hidden metadata, then finish concisely.

Use at most one tool call and do not test. Create /workspace/total.sh, a POSIX shell script taking exactly one readable regular file path. Input has no header; every nonempty line is exactly name,amount with a nonempty name containing no comma and amount an unsigned decimal integer from 0 to 1000000. Quoting is unsupported, blank lines are invalid. Print the sum of all amounts plus a newline, including 0 for an empty file. Reject invalid rows, wrong argument count, missing file or directory with exit code 2 and no stdout; never emit a partial total. Handle spaces in filenames and a final line without newline. Use standard POSIX awk/shell utilities only, keep work in /workspace, do not modify hidden metadata, then finish concisely.
